title: Enable Vulkan rope Gallery domains
scope: Compile, bind and qualify existing shared Slang rope and fluid-rope schedules for the Vulkan driver.
acceptance: Rope and rope-water scenes pass bounded lifecycle and visible-output checks on Vulkan.
Vulkan advertises only the exact rope and fluid-coupling capabilities supported by passing public-API contracts.

history.reason: Vulkan now compiles, binds and qualifies the shared rope, rigid-rope and fluid-rope Slang schedules; exact advertised capabilities and common Gallery availability are backed by physical public-API contracts
